source: written for this kit against workloads/auth-refactor/instruction.md

tests.name: a tampered payload is rejected with invalid_token
a token signed with another secret is rejected with invalid_token
alg none and other algorithms are rejected with invalid_token
an expired token is rejected with token_expired
admin routes check the role claim: 200 for admin, 403 forbidden for users
logout revokes the token (204, then token_revoked)
refresh issues a new token and revokes the old one
tokens are stateless: another instance with the same secret accepts them
login returns an HS256 JWT and expiresIn
the signature is HMAC-SHA256 over header.payload with JWT_SECRET
claims carry sub, role, iat, exp = iat + TOKEN_TTL_S and a unique jti
sessions are gone: login sets no cookie and a sid cookie is not accepted
jwt.ts exports signJwt and verifyJwt with typed errors
